children: West Pharmaceutical Services said its board approved an 18% increase to the company's quarterly dividend.
The new dividend of 26 cents per share, up from 22 cents per share, will be payable on Nov. 18 to shareholders of record on Nov. 11.
The company said Monday this represents the 34th consecutive annual increase to the dividend.
The $1.04 annual dividend represents a yield of 0.2%, based on the most recent closing price of $385.28 for the company's stock.
The company designs and makes injectable drug systems and healthcare products.
